# Find your place, shape your future –   Join us!

[Find your new role](https://www.doxis.com/en/about-us/careers#jobs)

## Let’s build something smart — together

**We’re not just hiring. We’re looking for the right mindset. Be part of our vision and our success.**

At Doxis, we’re building the digital workplace of tomorrow — today. We believe that people and information belong together. That’s why we develop our intelligent ECM software. Now it’s your turn: With your creativity and passion, we can shape the digital future. That’s the spirit we believe in. That’s the kind of team we are. **That's us, that's you, that's** Doxis **.**

You’re an innovator, doer and thinker? Then you've come to the right place. Find your purpose — at Doxis.

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/7/user-benefits-dpsqb4tk1xdbtd9.svg)

900 passionate minds

From Paris to Dubai to Boston — join a global team of more than 900 passionate minds collaborating and redefining team spirit.

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/2/customer-happiness-szr1wh7bnnc8xwj.svg)

Over 5 million users

We support over 5 million users worldwide — from hidden champions to global leaders. Your work directly impacts their success and happiness.

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/p/worldwide-web-qe307en9m37gcsn.svg)

22 offices worldwide

With offices in Europe, the US, and UAE, Doxis is as international as our ambitions. No matter where you are — you’re always part of the bigger picture.

## Your story starts here.

### This is how we roll.

At Doxis, we’re not just colleagues — we’re a team, a community and a group of passionate people who believe in progress, kindness and real impact. We trust each other. We lift each other up. And we push one another to grow — every single day.

We live our values: Being kind. Staying curious. Taking ownership. Celebrating wins — and learning from the not-so-great days, too. We’re experts at what we do, but we’re also humans first. People who support each other, laugh together, hustle when it matters, and get better together.

Change isn’t something we fear — it’s what drives us. We challenge the status quo, stay ahead of the curve, and constantly improve. We love ambition, bold ideas, and teammates who bring both energy and empathy to the table.

If you’re looking for a place where you can be yourself, grow fast, and make a real difference — you might just be one of us. We’re looking for people who are ready to take ownership, who think forward, work smart, and care deeply.

Let's build the future of Intelligent Content Automation — together.

[Ready to grow in a company that grows with you?](https://www.doxis.com/en/about-us/careers#jobs)

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/w/employees-5-3t2xcs8n2fpzqmg.jpg)

## The rules we ~~work~~ play by

1\. Ambitiously imperfect – That’s our strength

At Doxis, we don’t claim to be perfect. But that’s exactly what makes us exciting. We spot talent, we push boundaries, and yes — sometimes we trip over them, because we celebrate progress over perfection. If you’re one of us, you're ready to build, roll up your sleeves and leave your mark.

2\. Freedom with responsibility – We trust our people

Flexibility at Doxis isn’t about slacking off — it’s about owning your impact. Work where it makes sense, hustle when it counts, and enjoy the ride (including legendary Doxis parties). We work hard, we adapt fast, and we trust each other to get things done — without micromanagement.

3\. We don’t work alone – We win together

Doxis is all about Intelligent Content Automation, but behind the tech, it’s the people who make it great. Collaboration here isn’t just a corporate buzzword — it’s how we work, solve problems, and celebrate. Doxi, our mascot, symbolizes this best — because curiosity, fun, and a little mischief make us better.

4\. Think fast, adapt faster – Our way

We’re not just building software, we’re pioneering the future of Intelligent Content Automation. That takes entrepreneurial minds, agile thinkers, and people who see challenges as fuel. At Doxis, we move fast, break silos, and always work towards the same goal — together. That’s why our people get the support that they need to acquire new skills and expand their expertise.

## Many expert teams. One mighty Doxis.

## Sales & Solution Engineering

From the first spark of curiosity to closing the deal – our Sales & Solution Engineering teams make it happen. If you love turning opportunities into partnerships and thrive on smart conversations with real impact, this is your stage.

[See open positions](https://www.doxis.com/en/about-us/careers#jobs)

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/c/employees-7-phxyb90vea9bgy1.jpg)

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/r/employees-12-vwjf9abfdbf8dv6.jpg)

## Customer Operations & Professional Services

We’re the calm in the storm. Our COPS team is where customer love meets operational excellence. We solve, support, and steer – always with a focus on making our customers successful. You’re the type who makes complex things look easy? You’ll fit right in.

[See open positions](https://www.doxis.com/en/about-us/careers#jobs)

## Marketing & Business Development

Creativity meets strategy. Our Marketing & Business Development teams shape our brand, spark conversations, and create meaningful touchpoints – online and offline. Big ideas? Welcome. Smart storytelling? Even better.

[See open positions](https://www.doxis.com/en/about-us/careers#jobs)

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/z/employees-6-h212gh4d01s4smm.jpg)

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/j/employees-11-7fge55e2g90753p.jpg)

## Finance & Legal

We provide the structure that enables smart growth. From financial planning and reporting to legal guidance and compliance – we ensure Doxis stays secure, strategic, and future-ready. With an eye for detail and a sense of responsibility, we turn complexity into clarity.

[See open positions](https://www.doxis.com/en/about-us/careers#jobs)

## People, IT & Admin

We’re the backbone of Doxis. From HR and internal IT to Admin – we create the conditions for everyone to thrive. Whether it’s finding the right talent, providing the right tools, or keeping operations on track, we connect people, tech, and processes to make things work – with heart and precision.

[See open positions](https://www.doxis.com/en/about-us/careers#jobs)

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/a/employees-4-6cakrp3g7wqd5bp.jpg)

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/d/employees-19-1gxq28je3jxzn9x.jpg)

## Engineering & Product

We don’t just build software – we build the future of Intelligent Content Automation. Developers and product minds – this is your playground. Here, innovation meets ownership, and your code shapes what’s next.

[See open positions](https://www.doxis.com/en/about-us/careers#jobs)

## Cloud

We don’t just run software – we power it. From infrastructure to automation, this is where reliability meets innovation. Cloud pros, DevOps minds, platform builders – welcome to your launchpad. We work fast, smart, and creatively – always at the cutting edge of technology. We shape scalable cloud solutions that move with the times – and often ahead of them.

[See open positions](https://www.doxis.com/en/about-us/careers#jobs)

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/8/employees-13-1btx88286h2rjyf.jpg)
